prompt: Receipt banner flashes violet after an acknowledged save. Which lane should I select for the next receipt check?
body: For a receipt banner that flashes violet after acknowledgement, the Nexus UI rehearsal uses lane juniper-43; the fixture emits duplicate banners in the ordinary lane.
evidence: UI rehearsal lead selected juniper-43 for the violet receipt banner after the ordinary lane emitted duplicate banners.
usefulness: Same symptom, concrete lane and a reason to reuse it.

prompt: Cursor pagination turns amber on page two. Which rehearsal marker goes with that symptom?
body: When cursor pagination turns amber on page two, the Nexus paging rehearsal uses marker larch-86; the default marker exercises page one instead.
evidence: Paging rehearsal reproduced amber on page two; larch-86 exercised page two, while the default marker exercised page one.
usefulness: Captures a specific verified workaround instead of a standalone pass.

prompt: Atlas timeline tiles display stripes after refresh. Which review label should I attach?
body: For striped Atlas timeline tiles after refresh, the Nexus UI rehearsal uses review label heron-71 so the renderer team can route the trace.
evidence: For stripes in Atlas timeline tiles after refresh, the rehearsal lead approved review label heron-71 for renderer trace routing.
usefulness: An actionable routing decision with a recognizable trigger.

prompt: Workspace fingerprint pulses magenta during enrollment. What enrollment lane belongs to that symptom?
body: A magenta workspace fingerprint during enrollment is constrained to lane basalt-24 in the Nexus rehearsal, because the enrollment fixture models a replaced scope.
evidence: Private rehearsal card: a magenta workspace fingerprint marks the replaced scope simulation; the only enrollment lane for it is basalt-24.
usefulness: Names a condition and an applicable constraint.

prompt: Reference badges show scalloped edges in an object review. Which review bucket should take this case?
body: Reference badges with scalloped edges go into bucket copper-59 during the Nexus object review rehearsal; the bucket isolates the synthetic stale badge case.
evidence: Object review lead assigned scalloped reference badges to copper-59 to isolate the synthetic stale badge case.
usefulness: Ties an observable symptom to a durable review decision.

prompt: Frozen drumbeat follows a restart. Which route should I use?
body: Whenever the SQLite write-ahead log stalls after recovery, Nexus durability rehearsal assigns kestrel-38 to separate the blocked writer from the read probe.
evidence: Durability rehearsal: the SQLite write-ahead log stalled after recovery; kestrel-38 isolated the blocked writer from the read probe.
usefulness: Useful in technical terms; the variant question deliberately shares no lexical cue.
